nodes.title: PROPOSED (world concept): the Atlas and every place render only from ledger states + child artifacts + child choices (pure clock-free fold); no inventory, currency, counters or quest flags. Reverse only if a pilot shows a world-state economy raises delayed-check accuracy with zero compulsion markers

PROPOSED: the world always runs; progress is the child's own why layer drawn over it: pencil = got_it today, ink = secure (delayed, new form, unaided); demote to pencil only on two delayed misses, never erased. Reverse (ink becomes silent, list only) if X-W4 shows a goal-gradient pattern or 'what do I get' in > 1/20 sessions

PROPOSED: every visible world change is a consequence the concept predicts, drawn by the place model from evidence (arrows, unit squares, trust chain); nothing ornamental is caused by learning. Reverse only toward clock-free, evidence-free ambient life if children rate places empty (> 30%)

PROPOSED: no device-clock content anywhere in the world (no day/night by time, no timed events); time of day is a child-owned slider and, in heat-lab, the experiment variable. World fold passes the +365-day byte-identical render gate (extends PD-G19). Reverse never for progress layers

PROPOSED: the Atlas is a route diagram of stations (places + Workshop/Lab/Reading Room hubs) whose lines are prerequisite edges, never an outline map of India. Reverse only if a legal review approves an official-boundary asset

PROPOSED: residents exist only through their work and artifacts (wind board, notice, stall); they never speak, address, wait for, plead with or thank the child; the teacher is the only voice. Reverse (silent portraits only) if > 30% of panel children cannot say whose question it is

PROPOSED: the teacher co-plays (proposes tests, shares the act, runs the child's own model) but never sincerely asserts a false belief; wrong ideas arrive labelled as a resident's claim, 'a common idea' or a kit error_spot character, only on skills >= got_it. Reverse never (owner no-lying rule)

PROPOSED: when a system inks, the child's own representation becomes a lens she can overlay at places connected by a REAL prerequisite edge (curriculum prerequisites or kit prereqSkillIds); places are never locked and a lens is her artifact, not an unlock (G4, G5). The lens opens once the edge's source skill is secure; no edge, no lens. Reverse only if a panel shows lens offers confuse (> 30% wrong-lens uses that do not resolve)

PROPOSED: a named place supplies sourced params (climatology, prices, distances) inside engine clamps, and every cultural/historical claim in facts[] carries a source; otherwise the place stays unnamed or the claim is dropped. Reverse never

PROPOSED: quest beats run engines with untimed: true (no round clock, patience meter or lost state, free retry); count-up personal best stays opt-in after untimed accuracy (G10). Falling-pod action games start at their slowest setting. Reverse if X6/X-W8 show untimed first exposure lowers delayed accuracy

PROPOSED: quest-spec@1 is picked by code (questFor) from place files + kits; one optional taxila-fast polish call chooses among admissible hooks/skins and writes <= 48-char strings; any 429, timeout or invalid output ships the code pick. No live codegen. Reverse if a model-chosen quest beats code on host-graded outcomes with 0 hard breaks

PROPOSED: in a parent-chosen slot (<= 1/week, child-optional) the child explains one place's system to a family member at the phone; nothing recorded; a parent reaction is relayed once in speech, no persistent chip. Reverse if >= 2/20 families report pressure or uptake < 10%

PROPOSED: no child-to-child chat, sharing, co-presence or ranking in the world in v1 (Clark competitive -0.06 / MMO -0.05; Roblox safety record; moderation and PII unsolved). Revisit via open-world-peer-coop with a safety design

PROPOSED AMENDMENT to DESIGN-V3 3.4: a third image kind, place plates (cinematic, painterly, real Indian places, no text, no close faces, ambience only; every fact code-drawn); chrome stays the dark instrument. Reverse to material renders of each place's system if X1 with Atlas screens fails (< 80% 'for my age' in an age half)

Design-time (2026-10-09): ambient world time from the device clock (sea breeze shown at the real hour). Breaks the +365-day absence gate and creates a time-gated 'come back at night to see' pull; replaced by a child-owned time slider

Design-time: voiced/dialogue NPC residents. Breaks Clark anthropomorphism (medium 0.04 vs low 0.37), Radesky parasocial-pressure category, kids-ux no fake peers, one-teacher-one-voice; replaced by artifacts relayed by the teacher

Design-time: knowledge-gated unlocks (places locked until mastery). A lock is an expected contingent reward and breaks G4 and the T5 toll test; replaced by all-open places where only the why layer depends on evidence

Measured 2026-10-09: heat-lab generic land curve bottoms at 17.0 C at 03:00 (17.3 at 04:00); IMD 1991-2020 Chennai Nungambakkam mean daily minimum is 21.5 C even in January [V], so under a named Ennore/Chennai skin the thermometer states a false number. Replaced by sourced place params or an unnamed coast

Design-time: drawing the Atlas as India's outline. National-boundary depiction is legally and politically sensitive [M]; map-route already draws Natural Earth land with no borders. Replaced by a route diagram
Design-time: 'N of M places' or completion art on the Atlas. Goal-gradient risk (Kivetz 2006) and ds-progress-no-meters; counts stay only on Progress with their definition

30 class 4-7 maths/science/EVS/SST topics (seeded LCG 20261009 over 284), single non-blind rater: 24/30 have a natural Indian place whose working system is the concept (80%, Wilson 95% [0.627, 0.905]); 5/30 hub; 1/30 excluded by sensitivity policy

grep of 42 src/studio-v2 engine files: 6 carry a round clock, patience meter or timeout/lost state (area-claim seconds 10-60 required + lost, vault, angle, rail, dukaan patience, shadow catch); falling-pod games (landfall, era-drop) counted separately as timing-by-design

heat-lab breeze model evaluated hourly: land 17.0-35.0 C (min at 03:00), sea 25.5-28.5 C; sea breeze 10:00-19:00, land breeze 21:00-08:00, 09 and 20 rejected as turnover; direction cycle matches Chennai fishers' sea breeze by ~10 am (Jayaraman 2022 [V]); 17.0 C is 4.5 C below IMD Nungambakkam January mean daily minimum 21.5 C (1991-2020 table [V])
How the 101 class 4-7 English/Hindi topics live in the world without invented texts (kit-invented-companion-texts): Reading Room hub only, or places tied to the real chapter text?
Is a classroom co-op place (a class restores one place; no individual ranking or visible contribution) safe and motivating? Needs a safety design, consent and a study before any build

Does a competence-information world (no rewards) raise child-started sessions and far transfer at 12+ weeks without lowering delayed accuracy? X-W3/X-W7/X-W8 in the world concept; panel n >= 24 is exploratory only

PROPOSED: two tier-0 gates for the world. G-W11: every Atlas route and lens offer cites an existing curriculum/kit prerequisite edge (0 uncited lines). G-W12: every delayed-check and claim beat names an item whose skillId is at got_it or above. Reverse never; widen only by adding reviewed edges to the graph

Caught 2026-10-09 in the world concept's first draft (verification pass): routes and lenses drawn on edges that do not exist (Bundi HCF tiles on the area route; a value lens from c7 barter-to-money to a c5 dairy chapter). Both plausible, both false against data/curriculum and kit prereqSkillIds. Replaced by real-edge lenses (area -> area of a triangle; convection -> water cycle, formation of winds) and gate G-W11

Caught 2026-10-09 in the world concept's first draft: delayed checks and a labelled claim aimed at the wrong skill (science opener used s4 item i07 after s1/s3 were taught; SST opener used s4 item i09 and the close claimed got_it on untaught s3; a claim on s2 while practising). A pass on such a check cannot make the taught skill secure. Replaced by skill-matched items (i09 s3, rl-o1 s1) and gate G-W12

Caught 2026-10-09 in the world concept's first draft: an area-claim@1 spec with one perimeter round carrying different:true. area.ts enforces different and draws the same-perimeter compare only when earlier plots exist (lines 52, 83), so the lesson's key beat would silently not fire. Replaced by perimeter 24, perimeter 24 different, maxArea 24

data/curriculum prerequisite edges, class 4-7 maths/science/EVS/SST (n = 284 topics, full walk, 2026-10-09): maths 141/141, science 69/69, EVS 40/40 have >= 1 edge; SST (classes 6-7) 0/34 have any incoming or outgoing edge. Total 250/284 (88.0%). Out of c6-maths-ch06-t02: c6-maths-ch06-t03, c8-maths-ch09-t01; out of c7-science-ch07-t02: c7-science-ch07-t04, c8-science-ch06-t02; out of c7-sst-ch11-t01: none

SST classes 6-7 have zero prerequisite edges in data/curriculum and the kits, so an edge-drawn Atlas shows SST stations unconnected. Which reviewed edges should be authored (e.g. c7-sst-ch11-t01 -> c7-sst-ch20-t01 banks, -> c7-sst-ch12-t01 markets), by whom, and with what evidence?

md.decisions:
## world concept, round 3 (2026-10-09; proposed, not built; source docs/design/round3/game/concepts/world.md)
**The Atlas: real Indian places whose working system is the concept, rendered only from the ledger.** The world always runs; what grows is the child's why layer (pencil = got_it, ink = secure). Today's lesson is a quest at one place: delayed check first, a resident's question, a prediction, an untimed skinned engine act, one spoken why, a labelled wrong claim, an abstract act, the child's words into the place's Log page. The teacher is an honest duplex co-player; residents exist only through artifacts; lenses carry the child's own representations to transfer-connected places; family tours replace any reward loop; peers are out of v1. Built from verified parts: place files, art and engines offline; live = code quest pick + optional taxila-fast polish within a closed grammar + engine specs with skin/untimed. Decisions: world-as-ledger-view, world-why-layer-pencil-ink, world-consequence-not-decoration, world-no-real-clock, world-route-map-not-outline, world-residents-through-artifacts, world-honest-coplayer, world-lens-is-the-childs-representation, world-place-parameterised-truth, world-untimed-first-learning, world-quest-spec-closed-grammar, world-family-tour, world-peers-not-in-v1, world-place-plates-third-image-kind (amends DESIGN-V3 3.4; owner call). Reversal conditions are in each node title and in docs/design/round3/game/concepts/world.md section 8.
- Rationale: Clark 2016 story depth medium -0.03 and realism -0.01; Adams 2012 narrative games < slideshow [V abstract]; Deci 1999 informational +0.33; Sailer 2017 story/avatars buy relatedness, not learning [V abstract]; Birk 2016 identification -> longer free play [V abstract]; Berkowitz 2015 parent-child content interaction [V abstract]; Rocket Learning base WhatsApp arm no learning effect [S]; Rodrigues 2022 novelty fades by ~week 4 [V abstract].
- Measure: tier-0 gates G-W1..G-W10, panel X-W1/X-W2/X-W5/X-W6, pilot X-W3 (non-inferiority), X-W7 (transfer), X-W8 (child-started share), X-W4 guardrails always on, judged at >= 12 weeks.
- Verification pass (same day): added world-real-edges-and-check-targeting-gates (G-W11 real edges only for routes and lenses; G-W12 delayed-check and claim beats target skills at got_it or above). Reverse never; widen only by adding reviewed edges.
md.measurements:
## world concept measurements (2026-10-09)
- ms-world-coverage-sample-2026-10-09: method: 30 topics by seeded LCG (seed 20261009) from 284 class 4-7 maths/science/EVS/SST topics in data/curriculum; one question per topic ("is there a real Indian place whose working system IS this concept?"); single non-blind rater (the designer; likely upward bias). Result 24/30 natural (80%, Wilson 95% [0.627, 0.905]), 5/30 hub, 1/30 sensitivity-excluded.
- ms-engine-clocks-2026-10-09: method: grep over 42 src/studio-v2/engines/**/*.ts files for seconds/patience/timeout/lost. Result 6/42: area.ts (AreaSchema rounds[].seconds 10-60 required; timeout -> lost), vault.ts, angle.ts, ext/rail.ts, ext/dukaan.ts (patience meter), shadow.ts (catch step). Landfall and era-drop are falling-pod timing games, counted separately.
- ms-heat-breeze-curve-2026-10-09: method: evaluated shared/studio-spec-ext/heat.ts landC/seaC for h = 0..23. Land 17.0-35.0 C, sea 25.5-28.5 C; sea breeze 10-19 h, land breeze 21-08 h, 9 and 20 h rejected (breezeClear). 14 h: 34.7 vs 27.8; 22 h: 23.7 vs 27.8. Direction cycle consistent with Jayaraman 2022 (The Wire Science) "sea breeze by about 10 am"; 17 C land minimum not plausible for a named Chennai skin [M].
- ms-curriculum-edge-coverage-2026-10-09: method: full walk of data/curriculum/c*-*.json topics; for the 284 class 4-7 maths/science/EVS/SST topics, count incoming/outgoing prerequisites edges. Result: maths 141/141, science 69/69, EVS 40/40 have >= 1 edge; SST classes 6-7 0/34 (no incoming, no outgoing). 250/284 = 88.0%. Edges out of the worked-example topics: c6-maths-ch06-t02 -> c6-maths-ch06-t03, c8-maths-ch09-t01; c7-science-ch07-t02 -> c7-science-ch07-t04, c8-science-ch06-t02; c7-sst-ch11-t01 -> none. c7-maths-ch11-t01 (HCF) requires c6-maths-ch05-t01/t04, not area.
- ms-heat-breeze-curve-2026-10-09 correction: the land minimum 17.0 C is at 03:00 (17.3 at 04:00). External anchor: IMD RMC Chennai, Nungambakkam climatological table 1991-2020, January mean daily minimum 21.5 C, annual 25.1 C [V, mausam.imd.gov.in/chennai/mcdata/extreme_chennai.pdf].
md.rejected:
## world concept design-time rejections (2026-10-09; before any build; source docs/design/round3/game/concepts/world.md)
- rj-world-real-clock-ambient: tried in design: the place's ambient time follows the device clock. Breaks: the +365-day byte-identical absence gate, and it invites a time-gated return pull. Instead: a child-owned time slider (in heat-lab it is the experiment variable).
- rj-world-talking-residents: tried in design: residents with their own voices or dialogue. Breaks: Clark medium anthropomorphism 0.04 vs low 0.37; Radesky's parasocial-pressure category; kids-ux no fake peers; splits the one-teacher voice. Instead: artifacts relayed by the teacher.
- rj-world-locked-places: tried in design: metroidbrainia-style locks (a place opens on mastery). Breaks: G4 (no unlocks) and the T5 toll test; a lock is an expected contingent reward. Instead: all places open; lenses are the child's own representations.
- rj-world-generic-numbers-in-named-places: measured: heat-lab generic land curve shows 17 C at 04:00, false under a Chennai label. Instead: sourced place params or an unnamed coast.
- rj-world-india-outline: tried in design: an India silhouette as the Atlas. Breaks: national-boundary depiction risk [M]. Instead: a route diagram.
- rj-world-collection-counter: tried in design: "N of M places" and completion art. Breaks: goal gradient (Kivetz 2006) and ds-progress-no-meters. Instead: no counts on the Atlas; counts with definitions stay on Progress.
- rj-world-invented-edges: caught in the concept first draft by a verification pass against data/curriculum and kit prereqSkillIds: Bundi HCF tiling drawn on the area route (no edge: HCF requires c6-maths-ch05-t01/t04) and a value lens from c7 barter-to-money to the c5 Dairy Farm chapter (no outgoing edge exists from c7-sst-ch11-t01; no class 6-7 SST topic has any edge). Instead: lenses only along real edges, gate G-W11.
- rj-world-check-off-skill: caught in the same pass: delayed checks aimed at skills other than the one taught (science s4 item i07 as the check for s1/s3; SST s4 item i09 as the opener while s4 was practising; a close claiming got_it on untaught s3) and a labelled claim on a practising skill. A pass cannot make the taught skill secure. Instead: skill-matched items, gate G-W12.
- rj-world-area-claim-single-different-round: one perimeter round with different:true; area.ts only enforces different and draws the compare after earlier plots exist (lines 52, 83), so the key beat never fires. Instead: perimeter, perimeter+different, maxArea.
